# v2026.10.38

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.38.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.38.md).

This release covers **3 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Work › Reconcile shows each done job with no invoice, and each Flow invoice with no job, so a person can link, make an invoice or skip. ([#191](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/191))
- The job panel marks a job with no invoice as "Needs invoice", with Make invoice and Reconcile buttons. ([#191](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/191))
- Integrations › Xero › Import links copied Xero invoices to Flow invoices, links sure matches by itself, and makes Flow invoices for the rest when asked. ([#191](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/191))
- The Jobs list has ticks, folding groups and the bulk action bar: set a custom field, mark ready, draft invoices, copy or export. ([#198](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/198))
- The Jobs list has a Columns menu, a separate column for each date, coloured Stage labels and Group: None. ([#198](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/198))
- Each lab gets an Assignee field, with an "Assignee: me" filter. ([#198](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/198))

## Changes

- Work › Reconcile matches Flow jobs with Flow invoices, from Flow's own data, with no Xero or Seazona call. ([#191](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/191))
- Integrations › Xero › Import reviews copied Xero invoices one at a time or as a list, links them to Flow invoices, and searches the Xero history. ([#191](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/191))
- The Jobs list has ticks, folding groups, bulk actions, a Columns menu and an Assignee field. ([#198](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/198))
